concept: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: polished visual direction board for two offline mobile games for children aged 5–6, side by side two portrait gameplay mockups on a warm ivory art board. Primary request: redesign a flapping baby bird game and a jumping frog pond game, original flat joyful preschool cartoon art, clear chunky silhouettes, soft dark teal outlines, lively saturated mint green, sunny yellow, coral orange and sky blue, simple clean flat fills, no realism, no 3D, no textures, no generic vector wireframe. LEFT portrait: a round tiny golden bird with a coral neckerchief, a small beak, two normal expressive eyes and one readable wing, flying toward the right between chunky mint green rounded pipe obstacles above a flower meadow. Large open cyan sky. RIGHT portrait: an adorable green frog with cream tummy, two raised round eyes, anatomically readable tiny arms and large folded hind feet, side/three-quarter facing right, bouncing across lily pads in a blue pond. A SMALL FRIENDLY ORDINARY ORANGE FISH with a natural oval body, fan tail and tiny black eye is leaping nearby as a clearly visible obstacle, no teeth, no humanoid face, no creepy distorted shapes. Background reed clusters, round shrubs, lotus flowers, spare clouds. Both mockups have a tiny ivory circular home icon and pause icon at top left and large 0 at top right, no paragraphs, no tutorials. Gameplay objects should be clear against a quiet open background. Show beautiful actual gameplay compositions, not menu panels. No logos, no watermark. Each mockup in its own soft round-corner screen, no photoreal phone hardware.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game sprite atlas, one transparent PNG. Original preschool flat cartoon game art matching the reference bird/frog visual direction: clean thick softly rounded dark teal outlines, simple bright flat color fills, friendly sunny yellow, mint/lime green, coral orange, blue. No realistic rendering, no painterly texture, no 3D, no written text or watermarks. Make a perfectly regular 3 column by 2 row atlas, canvas landscape 1536 by 1024, 6 equally sized square cells 512 by 512. No visible grid and no labels. Every sprite centered inside its own cell, fully contained with generous 60px transparent padding on each side, never touch a neighbor. First row left: round baby golden bird flying RIGHT, coral scarf, wing raised. First row middle: EXACT SAME bird flying RIGHT, wing lowered, same scale and body pose. First row right: adorable green frog sitting in right-facing three-quarter profile, large expressive raised eyes, cream tummy, small front arms and properly folded large hind legs, simple readable anatomy, friendly smile. Second row left: EXACT SAME frog jumping RIGHT with hind legs extended behind, same head size. Second row middle: a completely ordinary friendly ORANGE GOLDFISH leaping diagonally upward RIGHT about 40 degrees, natural oval fish body, distinct fan tail and fins, one small dark eye, closed little mouth, no human face, no teeth, not a tadpole, no water behind it. Second row right: small friendly blue dragonfly facing LEFT with four broad translucent pale cream wings and one simple pair of eyes, ordinary dragonfly anatomy, no humanoid face. Isolated transparent sprites only, no scene, no floor, no shadows, no particles, no backgrounds. Match reference character identities but simplify details for readability at 45–70 pixels tall.

cleanup: Edit target: the attached 3-column, 2-row transparent game sprite atlas. Change ONLY transparency around the six characters: completely REMOVE ALL colored outer glow, ambient haze, smoke, halos and shadows around every sprite. Empty space must be absolutely fully transparent right up to the clean anti-aliased dark outline of each character. Preserve the exact six character drawings, poses, cell positions, colors, proportions and canvas 1536x1024. No visible background at all. No soft glow. No labels. Keep the clean flat original cartoon sprite art unchanged. Production alpha cutout sprite atlas.
